messages:
incident-bot: P1 ALERT — unusual staging proxy log exports detected. Source: log-forwarder-2 (staging). ~8k objects written to s3://redwood-staging-dump/edge/ at 03:12 UTC. Possible debug dump containing auth headers. Pager: @sre-oncall @sec_lead

incident-bot: Immediate suggested actions: pause forwarder, snapshot bucket, rotate keys, preserve chain-of-custody.

sre-oncall: On it. Pulling last 1h delivery logs. Can we pause forwarder?

ops_lead: Yes please. @kevin can you disable staging forwarder write role (svc-forwarder-staging) and block outgoing to S3 for it?

kevin: I'm running revoke now: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable svc-forwarder-staging --project=redwood-staging` — hold

kevin: Done. Applied deny policy on bucket for that SA.

maria: Copy. I'll snapshot the bucket to preserve for forensics: `aws s3 cp --recursive s3://redwood-staging-dump s3://redwood-forensics-snap-3425123456` — starting

sec_lead: Important: preserve original objects' metadata (timestamps) and don't change names. Also create a signed URL list for investigators rather than downloading full copies.

alice: Running grep for authorization headers on a sample object: ```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-staging-dump/edge/proxy/part-0001.log - | grep -i "Authorization:"
``` — found tokens in ~12 entries

danny: Are these real customer tokens or internal? Any PII?

alice: Early look: mixed. Some internal service tokens, some customer bearer tokens embedded in logs. Need full customer impact assessment.

pm_jordan: @support-team please prepare a customer impact matrix for any exposed tokens and begin outreach plan drafts if needed. Tag customers with sensitive data.

sre-oncall: What's retention? How many customers affected estimate?

alice: Quick sample ~2% of objects contain headers; extrapolate ~1600 objects, ~1200 with bearer tokens. Could be multiple customers.

sec_lead: Rotate potentially exposed keys ASAP. Recommend: 1) Revoke S3 write SA (done). 2) Rotate all staging service tokens for forwarder consumers. 3) Rotate any API keys found in logs — coordinate with product for customer-facing keys.

kevin: I'll start rotating forwarder-consumer service account keys and create new rotation schedule. ETA 25m.

maria: Forensics note: do not run any destructive deletes. We need chain-of-custody. I will change bucket ACL to read-only for investigators.

sec_ops_bot: Checklist: incident declared security P1. Running automated scan for tokens in bucket (rules: bearer|api_key|aws_access_key). Scan triggered.

ops_lead: Incident timeline in #incidents-docs please. Assigning tasks: @danny check if any production ingress used same forwarder config; @alice enumerate customer ids; @sre-oncall coordinate rotation windows with low traffic.

danny: On it. I’ll grep prod configs and report in 15m.

pm_jordan: If customer tokens rotated, communications draft will depend on whether tokens are still valid. Keep legal looped: @legal@redwood

sec_lead: Keep evidence chain: store copies in secure forensics bucket with restricted ACL and an audit log entry.

kevin: Rotation progress: 4/14 consumers rotated, no errors. Will continue and post status.

alice: Running token revocation scan against auth service: found 7 unique customer tokens still active; revoking now.

alice: Revoked 7 tokens. Logging actions.

sre-oncall: Any live customer impact? Any production auth failures?

danny: Quick checks show no customer-facing outages. Some staging-only services affected. Noted.

pm_jordan: I'll prep a short customer notice template in #support in case outreach required.

sec_lead: Next steps: finish rotation, complete forensics snapshot, update timeline, prepare comms. Owners: @kevin (rotation), @maria (forensics), @alice (token revocation), @danny (config audit), @sre-oncall (coord).

incident-bot: Incident P1 acknowledged. If any external reach, tag incident number INC-2026-3425.

kevin: Rotation complete for remaining consumers. All rotated.

maria: Forensics snapshot complete, write-only archive created at s3://redwood-forensics-snap-3425123456.

alice: Final scan: no remaining active exposed tokens in staging bucket. Marking initial mitigation done.

sre-oncall: Closing active mitigation phase. Keeping incident open for postmortem and customer impact assessment.

pm_jordan: Assigned postmortem owner @danny. ETA 48h.

sec_lead: Also schedule a review: ensure forwarder excludes auth headers and redaction is enabled by default.

kevin: Created PR to enforce header redaction in forwarder config, will push to staging tomorrow.

alice: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
